reference.criterion: Ordinary population life expectancy/expected lifespan exceeds 100 years, not a few individuals living past 100.
reference.rationale: Observed 2019 US life expectancy was 78.8 years, far below 100. CDC’s 2024 estimate is 79.0 years. Cohort hopes or exceptional centenarians do not establish ordinary life expectancy over 100.
